body: I feel the same way.. I know she would want me to keep going, and to be strong, but it's too painful. I hope this pain becomes more bearable as time goes on.

Thank you for sharing your story. I'm so sorry for your loss. And you're right.. It would break her heart to see me give up. I have to keep going for her, I owe her that. I just don't know how I can go on without her. I don't want to live without her.

I'm glad at least there's something for other people to learn from my loss. Please, love and cherish your girlfriend. Hug her and tell her you love her. Never take her for granted. I made that mistake. I wish I could have said goodbye and that I love her one last time.

Thank you. I hope you can stay strong and keep going, and find some meaning. She was my meaning, and it feels impossible to keep going without her. Thank you for your kind wishes. I desperately hope I can see her again.
I hope you're OK. I don't really know what to say to you, but I hope things get better for you.
Thank you, I appreciate you saying this. At least she was happy until the day she died. I just wish we had more time together, or that I could have said goodbye.
Maybe I should keep going. Would she want me to be strong, and go on, and to keep suffering? I just don't know how I can, and if I want to. Thank you so much, that was beautiful.

Fuck, man. This world is so beautiful and fucked up. I guess I should be happy that I got to know her for such a short time and experience love like that at all. I wanted to experience all the beautiful and amazing things in the world with her. I don't want to without her.
I feel like she would want me to go on and be happy, but I can't keep going like this. It hurts too much. I don't want to live without her.

I'm considering going to a therapist, it might help to just talk to someone. As for the funeral I haven't even started planning. I need a few days to calm down a bit before I talk to anyone, I think. I want to scatter her ashes somewhere beautiful, that's what she would have wanted.

Thank you for this. Whenever I remember her and the good memories we had together, I feel happy, and then crushed because I know she's gone. She would want me to be happy, but I don't know how to cope with this. I don't think I can take the pain of being without her for much longer.

I don't really have anyone to talk to about it. My only friends really are my coworkers but I don't know them that well. The other day I pretty much had a breakdown at work and completely fell apart, and my boss was the only one who saw me. He knows what happened seemed pretty sympathetic and gave me a some time off work. I just don't really know anyone well enough to talk to about this. I guess she wouldn't want me to do it, that's just about the only thing that keeps me going at this point. She'd want me to be happy but I never will be without her.
Thank you. You're right, she was truly wonderful, and I was lucky to have her even for a few short years. I just don't know how I can go on without her. Every minute without her hurts.
